[IARC.9.1] **Module decomposition.** The
shipped layout is a nine-module shape: engine, wm,
schema, agenda, dispatcher, recorder, telemetry,
clock, json — plus the public `libds.h` header. Of
these, engine / wm / schema / agenda / recorder / json
each own a public opaque type ([IARC.6.2]); dispatcher
/ telemetry / clock own none.
